biggest_catch: This is gambling, not income: prediction-market contracts can lose 100%, the $50 credit is non-withdrawable, and there is no guaranteed payout of any kind.
catches: Prediction markets are gambling: contracts settle at $1 or $0, and a losing position can lose 100%.
The $50 is non-withdrawable trading credit; only profits earned by trading it can be withdrawn.

The offer is distributed through rotating affiliate promo codes (codes seen: WSN, DIMERS, ROCKY, ACTION, COVERS, LABS, SIBONUS), and amounts/requirements differ across affiliates (e.g., one variant required a $20 deposit), so the exact terms depend on which code campaign is live.

Polymarket's own site states trading is blocked in the United States on polymarket.com and directs US users to polymarket.us, the CFTC-regulated exchange; availability is state-limited (affiliates report exclusions including AZ, IL, MA, MD, MI, MT, NV, NJ, OH, WA, which must be confirmed in official terms).
One bonus per person; promo codes must be entered at registration and cannot be applied retroactively; bonus credits may expire if unused.
Identity verification is required before deposit and trading; KYC failure can forfeit the bonus.
Addiction risk: gambling problem resources (1-800-GAMBLER) are cited on affiliate disclosures.
